method: Complete draft packages and available patches were searched for candidate terms and category labels. PR #128 documents additions only for Allgemeinwissen, Länder, Städte and Tierwelt; PR #126 documents Football/Videogames/Culture additions. The other isolated packs use bridges/metro/heritage/space, rivers/dams/telescopes/museums/aircraft, TRAPPIST-1, elements and Tierwelt.
limitations: Counts describe proposed question additions, not UI/refactor PRs #57 and #109.
No open draft currently adds a question categorized as Rekorde & Extreme.
Main and Daily are separate inventories and are never summed.
